note: Ask the user in small groups, save exact answers, and show a final preview. Never invent contact details, subscription IDs, model names, requested amounts or submission consent.

steps.name: intent
questions: 입력·캡처만 할지, 검토 후 실제 신청까지 할지 확인합니다.
steps.consent: Submission intent is not approval to send an unseen payload.

steps.name: subscription
steps.note: Use a GUID, not the subscription display name. A row-specific GUID overrides the common GUID.

steps.name: justification
steps.note: A draft may be proposed from user-provided facts, but must be reviewed. Do not invent production usage, projected traffic or customer commitments.

steps.name: models
steps.note: Discover live choices. If a name is not an exact match, present candidates and wait for the user to choose.

steps.name: amount_and_region
steps.note: Ask for TOTAL existing+additional TPM, not capacity returned by an API. Ask for a region only when the selected model's live form shows the region question.

steps.name: review
questions: 공통정보와 모델별 입력값을 모두 보여주고 사용자의 명시적인 승인을 기다립니다.
steps.note: For a batch, one explicit approval can cover the exact displayed Y rows. Y alone is never approval.
